name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.LastPass.lastpass_walk
title: The regime-(d) walk: equality-cube flips and fat reroutes give the full witness-indexed hybrid argument
statement: Same scheme and hypotheses as fat_reroute, and Psi unsatisfiable. Then under decision LWE with k bits in the CVW18 regime, the real view (lastPassView with t = 0, eq labelled mask) and the final hybrid (t = 2^n, in which mask occurs only in the challenge) are CloseAt with loss 2 * 2^n * (h+1) * hopLoss(h, rows) and simulation cost simCost.
